en.title: Zalando Manipulation
en.description:
The string contains only A, B, C, D. You may repeatedly delete two adjacent characters that are A/B or C/D, in either order. Output any result that cannot be reduced further.

The standard input/output format and supplementary constraints stated by this site belong to the definition of the online version and do not pose as the source's original constraints.
en.input: One line with a string of length 0..250000, containing only A, B, C, D.
en.output: Output any irreducible string; for an empty result, output an empty line.
en.explanation: Maintain a stack from left to right. If the new character and the top of the stack form a mismatched A/B or C/D pair, pop; otherwise push.
hints: Maintain a stack from left to right. If the new character and the top of the stack form a mismatched A/B or C/D pair, pop; otherwise push.
